name: OberVave Performance Manual
base: PF3 + tested PF4 pattern bank + manual-only persistence

save_policy.preset: manual SAVE twice outside sequencer; program and globals/settings
save_policy.pattern: manual pattern SAVE or Bank 3 hold current; pattern snapshot and globals/settings
save_policy.copy: explicit copy or Bank 3 hold other; copied pattern and globals/settings
save_policy.favourite: hold 700 ms; favourite snapshot and sends only; preserves shared FX on recall
save_policy.navigation: no implicit flash write; save before switching or powering down
save_policy.deferred_requests: explicit saves wait for stop/quiet; require completion before power off
save_policy.effects: stored in pattern snapshot and global settings; loading a pattern restores its own saved FX

tests.manual_persistence: zero API writes on boot/edits/FX/octave/start-stop/pattern navigation; explicit preset/pattern/copy/favourite write and restart restore passed
tests.full_suite: ALL TESTS PASSED; plus SMK-specific manual storage and pattern tests
